assumptions: Starts from Mike's published list (through the 2025 playoffs); everything since comes from Sleeper.
All-time record counts only games played while still in contention for the Bria Bowl or the Sacko (same rule as the Tegridy Factor).
Playoff record and playoff wins are winners-bracket games only; losers-bracket (toilet bowl) games count toward the all-time record only.
Division title = best regular-season record in the division, ties broken by points scored.
Led/last in scoring uses Sleeper's regular-season points-for standings.
Perfect season = champion with no losses (and no ties) in counted games.
Titles, sackos and scoring bonuses count once the season/regular season is decided; playoff appearances once the playoffs begin; the record bonus updates every week.

asterisk_legend.*: 2019 and later only (Sleeper-era data). There is no ESPN-era data for this stat.

formula.record_bonus_note: The post says "every .25%". Read as every .025 of win% above/below .500, truncated toward zero. With that, 5 of the 12 published totals reproduce exactly and the rest are within 20 points; a literal .0025 step would be off by hundreds.

review_notes_for_mike: Kyle: published 505 but his stated formula gives 500 for his own numbers (+5). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Suze: published 280 but his stated formula gives 285 for his own numbers (-5). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Levi: published 215 but his stated formula gives 205 for his own numbers (+10). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Gabe: published 30 but his stated formula gives 20 for his own numbers (+10). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Jon: published -15 but his stated formula gives 5 for his own numbers (-20). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Ging: published -65 but his stated formula gives -75 for his own numbers (+10). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Zaid: published -195 but his stated formula gives -215 for his own numbers (+20). Kept as a frozen adjustment.
Levi went unbeaten in the 2024 regular season but is not a "perfect season" here (treated as unbeaten through the title).
Adam was last in scoring (-15) in 2025 per Sleeper standings, but the published bonus list has no matching entry.
Jon's published all-time win% is .493 but 81-94 is .463.

The post says "every .25%". Read as every .025 of win% above/below .500, truncated toward zero. With that, 5 of the 12 published totals reproduce exactly and the rest are within 20 points; a literal .0025 step would be off by hundreds.
